verdict.rationale: Jina Reader explicitly offers a hosted proxy pool ('x-proxy: auto') that rotates residential/datacenter IPs and auto-handles anti-bot challenges, directly matching the story. However, there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming its effectiveness on genuinely hard-to-scrape sites, and community reports show some auth/availability issues unrelated to proxy quality specifically. Missing for 10: independent verification of proxy success rates against hard anti-bot targets, more detail on proxy tiers/geolocation options.
